# `company.bank_lines`

Bank inbox lines: each transaction a statement file showed, kept in the bank's sign with its state. Never deleted.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this line. |
| `import_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with import_id + ordinal | — | bank_feed_imports.id | The import that brought the line in. |
| `ordinal` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with import_id + ordinal | — | — | Position among that import's new lines, from 0. |
| `account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_bank_lines_account_state, ix_bank_lines_fitid, uq_bank_lines_live_key | accounts.id | Account the line belongs to. |
| `line_key` | VARCHAR(120) | no | — | — | uq_bank_lines_live_key | — | fitid:<FITID> (with !<amount hash> when the bank reused the id for another amount), or hash:<24 hex> of the line and its occurrence in the file. |
| `fitid` | VARCHAR(255) | yes | — | — | ix_bank_lines_fitid | — | The bank's own transaction id; null when the file gave none. |
| `date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | ix_bank_lines_account_state | — | Posted date, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `amount` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Minor units in the bank's sign: positive is money in, or a card payment. |
| `payee` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Payee or description as the bank printed it. |
| `memo` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Memo as the bank printed it. |
| `number` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Check or reference number as the bank printed it. |
| `kind` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | OFX transaction type (DEBIT, CHECK...); empty for CSV. |
| `state` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | ix_bank_lines_account_state | — | Where the line stands: waiting, matched, added, transfer, ignored, settled. |
| `live` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | 1 while its import stands; 0 once the import was reversed (its key is released). |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Optimistic-concurrency version of this line. |
| `entry_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_bank_lines_entry | transactions.id | The transaction the line is matched to (or, later, was added as); null while none. |
| `movement` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | The matched movement (its reconciliation key) as JSON; null while none. |
| `link_how` | VARCHAR(8) | yes | — | — | — | — | How the link was made: auto, person, agent, rule; null while none. |
| `match_reason` | VARCHAR(500) | yes | — | — | — | — | Why it matched, or what it was suggested against. |
| `possible_duplicate_of` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | bank_lines.id | A live line of the account this one probably repeats with cleaned-up text; null when none. |
| `warnings` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Warnings on the line (fitid_reused, possible_duplicate), as a JSON array. |
